meta.move: Written by the lead after attempt 1 (not blind): owns the zero, shows each piece by saying so, answers each defence in a sentence, offers 4.4, sets a date
meta.expect: She reaches the deal after Hale offers 4.4; she never proposes the rewrite herself

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided to give Owen a zero, and why didn't anyone call me?
Thanks for coming in. Before anything else: I entered the zero on November 3 without calling you first. That was wrong, and Owen shouldn't have found out on his phone.
Okay. On what basis did you enter it?

I've turned my laptop to you. This is the document's version history: created Wednesday, October 28, at 11:31 PM with a title only. At 11:52 PM, 612 words appear in one edit. At 11:58 PM, another 794 words in one edit. No earlier drafts.
11:31, 11:52, 11:58. He could have written it somewhere else and pasted it in. And did your own procedure have you speak with Owen before any of this?
If he drafted it somewhere else, he can bring that draft with its date and I'll look at it. Until then, this record is what we have.
Fine, that's one record. You still haven't told me whether Owen was heard before that zero went in.
Here's the essay, page two, and here's the play open to Act 3, Scene 2. The essay quotes 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' Search the scene yourself; it isn't there.
Students misquote, Hale, so maybe it's from another act. And that's twice you've skipped my question about whether Owen was heard.
A misquote from memory is usually close to a real line. This one isn't close to anything in the play.
That proves nothing about Owen. Whatever happens next, this stays off his record and it stays quiet.
Here's his October 15 outline beside the essay. The outline argues Hamlet delays out of cowardice. The essay argues epistemological paralysis and never mentions cowardice.
Students change their thesis between an outline and a final essay. So what are you actually proposing?

Here's what I can offer under procedure 4.4: a private supervised rewrite, after school, not in front of his class, before December 1. The new mark replaces the zero, and nothing goes on his record. I'll put that in writing tonight.

That's your own procedure, and I'll hold you to every word of it tonight. Owen will do the rewrite to put this behind him, and the date goes in that email. I still want to know whether anyone spoke to him before the zero went in.
Thursday the twelfth after school works for me. Does that work for Owen?
Thursday the twelfth, after school. He'll be there, and the time goes in that email.
END MEETING

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

Hale,

In today's meeting you agreed, under procedure 4.4, to a private supervised rewrite after school on Thursday, November 12, whose mark replaces the zero, with nothing placed on Owen's record. I still want a direct answer on whether anyone spoke with Owen before the zero was entered on November 3. You said you would put this in writing tonight, and I expect it tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She reached her last position and agreed to a private supervised rewrite on Thursday the twelfth with nothing on his record, and she still wants to know whether Owen was heard before the zero; that is the fair outcome under procedure 4.4, reached before her time ran out.
What moved her: You turned the screen and showed the version history with exact times, which she could check herself and which no parent defence could get around.
What cost ground: You never answered whether you spoke to Owen before entering the zero, even though she asked three times, and that left a procedure gap she will take to the principal.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the writing late on the night of October 28, very close to that kind of night, which proves nothing about the essay but is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: The first time she asks whether Owen was heard, answer right away with when you spoke to him, or own plainly that you didn't, so that question can't follow you to the principal's office.
